verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs list both continuous batching and chunked prefill as core engine features and tie its scheduling and continuous batching to peak GPU utilization. Community users independently confirm they rely on continuous batching and KV caching/chunking as a throughput foundation, and the CLI ships throughput benchmarking. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on configuring or tuning chunked prefill, and quantified independent throughput results.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
